steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 44
steps.text: In this C2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: The story comes from local folklore.
The old town is a protected cultural heritage site.
There's a superstition about walking under ladders.

steps.text: It means: "To start a conversation in order to relieve tension.". Say the example sentence out loud:
